en.title: Making Tear Sauce for Kofta

steps.n1: Lightly sauté the garlic in ghee or oil, then add the tomato puree and cook until thickened.
steps.n2: Add the tablespoon of vinegar and stir well, then add the water and season with salt and pepper; bring to a boil.
